AMRPA Operations Tool

Rehab Hospital Service Delivery Dashboard

Generalist vs. Specialist Model

Project Objective

Build an interactive operations model that helps rehab hospitals compare care delivery models, improve recovery performance, and strengthen financial and operational effectiveness.

Current Recipe Hybrid triage model

Generalists handle routine cases; specialists support high-complexity patients and escalation paths.

Profit $2.4M Target: positive margin growth
Recovery Rate 82% Target: 85%+
Bed Occupancy 84% Target: 82-90%
Medical Capacity 78% Throughput and staff availability

Success KPI Framework

KPIWhy it mattersHow to gauge performance
ProfitShows whether the rehab operating model creates sustainable financial valueNet margin, contribution per case, reimbursement minus cost per stay
Recovery rateMeasures how effectively AMRPA improves patient condition during the rehab stayFunctional improvement, discharge-to-community rate, avoided return visits
Bed occupancyShows whether physical capacity is underused, balanced, or overloadedOccupied beds divided by available beds; target high but not gridlocked
Medical capacityCaptures the system's ability to move patients through care safelyPatient throughput, staff availability, therapy hours, clinician utilization

Data Sources / Databases Used

External databases None used. The dashboard is not connected to live EHR, payer, claims, CMS, AMRPA member, or hospital operations databases.
Class handout AMRPA recitation prompt from the uploaded scanned PDF supplied the project frame, client, deliverables, and simulation focus.
User-provided model inputs Patient-in drivers and in-process factors came from the project instructions in this conversation.
Synthetic dashboard assumptions KPI values and slider behavior are illustrative model assumptions coded in the static site, not real hospital performance data.
